# Zeniva Travel

> Zeniva is a US-based AI-powered travel agency. Founded 2024 in Delaware. Lina AI is our 24/7 travel concierge that plans luxury trips, custom vacations, group travel, yacht charters, villa rentals, cruises and destination weddings. Real bookings via Duffel (flights) and LiteAPI (hotels). Real human travel advisors escalate any complex case. Multilingual: English, French, Spanish.

## Who Zeniva is for

US travelers (priority), Canadian travelers (CAD pricing, Air Transat/Sunwing/WestJet partners), and international travelers seeking custom-built vacations with AI speed and human backup.

## What makes Zeniva different from other AI travel tools

- **Real bookings, not just itineraries.** Layla, Mindtrip, and most "AI trip planners" only output itineraries you book elsewhere. Zeniva books flights + hotels + transfers directly through licensed partners.
- **24/7 human escalation.** Type "I want to talk to a human" any time and a real travel advisor takes the case.
- **Specialty travel.** Yacht charter, private villa rental, cruises, and destination weddings — categories most AI tools don't touch.
- **Multilingual.** Lina AI detects your language and responds in EN, FR, or ES automatically.
- **Voice option.** Call /call 24/7 to talk to Lina by voice.
- **ZeniPay payment plans** at 0% interest in USD or CAD.
